scope: historical prediction inputs that were legally fixed and publicly operative before a cycle cutoff, but require a later authoritative record for structured reconstruction
conditions: the fact was legally or operationally fixed before the information cutoff
independent evidence proves the fact was publicly operative or necessarily available before the cutoff
the later source merely records that already-fixed fact
reconstruction uses only factual fields required by the model
target outcome values are not consulted or imported
the fact could not have been changed based on the eventual election result
provenance, reconstruction source and availability proof remain separately fingerprinted
the rule is adopted before viewing or scoring the target holdout
explicitExclusions: polls or forecasts first published after the cutoff
later candidate withdrawals or substitutions not proven before the cutoff
election results, winners, vote totals, preference flows or observed swings
retroactive use of a later source as proof of pre-cutoff availability

2010Application.fact: final Legislative Assembly candidate slate and registered-party descriptions

fixityEvidence.evidence: official 2010 timetable records registered-party nominations closing 2010-11-11 and independent nominations closing 2010-11-12; the statutory failed-election exception is a candidate death between close of nominations and close of voting

publicOperationEvidence.evidence: the official 2010 election timeline records the close of early voting on 2010-11-25 and the report documents early-voting centres and ballot services for the ordinary 2010 election

independentCorroboration.evidence: VEC Annual Report 2010-11 records 101 early-voting centres and 543,763 early votes counted in the 2010 State election
